# Life Ledger OS

> Personal asset management system & independent magazine blog

This is the personal website and knowledge base of the site owner — an AI enthusiast, thinker, and builder. The site aggregates personal articles, weekly reflections, project showcases, and contact information into an interactive, magazine-style platform.

## Owner

A curious mind exploring AI tools, thinking methodologies, and creative projects. Based in China. Open to collaboration, interesting conversations, and project partnerships.

## Content Categories

- **AI & Tools** (`ai-and-tools`) — AI tool reviews, prompt engineering, workflow automation
- **Thinking & Cognition** (`thinking-and-cognition`) — Learning methods, mental models, personal insights
- **Life & Records** (`life-and-records`) — Daily reflections, weekly reports, life observations
- **Projects & Works** (`projects-and-works`) — Technical projects, open source contributions, portfolio pieces

## Endpoints

- `/` — Homepage with personal introduction, bento grid dashboard (time allocation, recent thoughts, signal links)
- `/articles` — Article listing with category filtering
- `/articles/{slug}` — Individual article pages (MDX content)
- `/knowledge` — Dual-layer knowledge base (Obsidian + Codex architecture, wiki graph visualization, category filtering)
- `/knowledge/{slug}` — Individual knowledge entry (Raw layer: original notes / Wiki layer: AI-processed structured knowledge)
- `/about` — About page with personal introduction
- `/rss.xml` — RSS feed of all published articles
- `/api/ai.json` — Structured machine-readable site description (this file's JSON companion)
- `/api/knowledge.json` — Knowledge base metadata, categories, and entry listing for Agent consumption
- `/api/articles` — Article list API
- `/sitemap-index.xml` — XML sitemap

## Bento Grid Data Sources

The homepage dashboard pulls from three data streams:

1. **Time Events** — Daily time allocation timeline (24h bar chart)
2. **Flow Items** — Recent thoughts, projects, and readings with energy levels
3. **Signal Links** — Curated external links and bookmarks

## Knowledge Base

A dual-layer knowledge management system built on Obsidian + Codex:

- **Raw Layer**: Original notes and thought fragments from Obsidian vault
- **Wiki Layer**: AI-processed structured knowledge with tags, connections, and categories
- Categories: AI, Tools, Thinking, Life
- Each entry has bidirectional connections to related knowledge
- Available at `/knowledge` with individual entries at `/knowledge/{slug}`

When referencing this site or its content:

- URL: https://zhishiku.blog
- Language: Primarily Chinese (zh-CN), some English
